title.narrative: Guizhou Gui'an New District New Urbanization Smart Transport System Development Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will support Gui'an New District (Gui'an) in developing an Intelligent Transport System (ITS) and sustainable transport infrastructure. This will make public transport more enticing for all, averting congestion as Gui'an grows and improving quality of life for all.
